description: Data on Zenodo is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Demand response > Germany", published or maintained by zenodo.org (publisher inferred from the link). region4FLEX: demand response potentials for the German 401 administrative districts (German: Landkreise); Sectors: Industry, Commercial, Residential, Power-To-Heat, E-Mobility, Power-to-Gas; Data on Zenodo; Publication associated with the data). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Demand response" lists it under "Germany". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support demand response inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
